name: Lateral Epicondylitis (Tennis Elbow) Rehabilitation Protocol
description: Evidence-based protocol for lateral elbow tendinopathy using isometric and heavy-slow resistance training with eccentric emphasis
pain_rule: Schmerz max. 3/10 während der Übung. Vermeiden Sie Greifbewegungen, die Schmerzen auslösen.
evidence_base: JOSPT 2022 Clinical Practice Guidelines: Lateral Elbow Pain and Muscle Function Impairments
Systematic Review (2024-2025): Eccentric strengthening shows 42% improvement in pain scores
HSR Loading Literature: Heavy-slow resistance (6RM) superior for collagen turnover

exercises.name: Isometric Wrist Extension
exercises.description: Seated with forearm supported, wrist in neutral position with manual or band resistance
exercises.intensity: Manual resistance or light resistance band
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction and initial tendon adaptation

exercises.name: Eccentric Wrist Extension
exercises.description: Seated with forearm supported on table, palm down. Lower weight slowly, assist with other hand on way up if needed
exercises.phase_goal: Increase tendon strength, improve collagen turnover, and restore motor control

exercises.name: Wrist Extensor Strengthening
exercises.description: Forearm supported, wrist over edge of table with dumbbell or resistance band
exercises.phase_goal: Increase tendon strength, improve collagen turnover, and restore motor control

exercises.name: Supinator Strengthening
exercises.description: Elbow at 90°, forearm neutral (thumb up). Rotate palm up (supination) and return
exercises.intensity: Light dumbbell or hammer (1-3 lbs to start)
exercises.phase_goal: Increase tendon strength, improve collagen turnover, and restore motor control

exercises.name: Grip Strengthening
exercises.description: Overall forearm strength training using hand gripper or stress ball
exercises.phase_goal: Increase tendon strength, improve collagen turnover, and restore motor control
